Deprecated: raw GAM fits and per-cell metrics

Source: R/janusplot.R
janusplot_data.Rd

janusplot_data() was renamed janusplot_fit() in janusplot 1.0.0 and forwards every argument to it. The result is the janusplot_fit object described there: pvalue_yx and pvalue_xy are now association_p_yx and association_p_xy, and first and second derivatives are computed by default.

Usage

janusplot_data(...)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed on to janusplot_fit

data

A data frame. Column names need not be syntactic; fits run under internal aliases and every result reports the original names.

vars

Character vector of numeric column names to fit, in matrix order. NULL (the default) takes every numeric column of data. Identical or exactly collinear columns are not fitted against each other; their cells are listed in flags$failed.

adjust

One-sided formula of covariates and random effects added to every pairwise model, for example ~ s(age) + s(site, bs = "re"). NULL (the default) fits unadjusted smooths. Character and logical adjust columns are converted to factor before fitting. Random-effect smooths are excluded from prediction, so the curve and its band are population-level. With the identity link (the Gaussian default) the curve is the smooth averaged over the adjustment covariates of the data, and the plots draw each point as a partial residual: the observation with its own adjustment replaced by that average, so points and curve share one level (style$adjusted_points). With another link, numeric covariates are held at their mean and fixed factors at their most frequent level, and points stay raw.

k

Basis dimension for s(): a single integer, or a named list of integers keyed by variable name. -1L (the default) leaves the choice to mgcv. Each cell's basis is capped at the number of distinct predictor values in its rows, and an auto_refit_k refit stops one below that number; capped cells are listed in flags$k_capped and recorded as k_requested, k_used and k_capped.

bs

Basis type for s(); "tp" (thin plate) by default.

engine

"bam" (the default) fits with mgcv::bam(), "gam" with mgcv::gam(). The two differ in their default method and by about one to three percent in EDF on the same data.

method

Smoothing-parameter estimation method passed to mgcv. NULL (the default) resolves to "fREML" for engine = "bam" and "REML" for engine = "gam".

na_action

"pairwise" (the default) fits each cell on the rows complete for its own variables and the adjust columns; "complete" first drops every row with a missing value in any fitted or adjusting column. Infinite values count as missing and are reported in a warning. A pair sharing fewer than 5 complete rows is not fitted and is listed in flags$sparse; an error is raised only when no pair reaches 5 rows.

n_grid

Number of equally spaced points at which each smooth and its derivatives are evaluated, at least 10. NULL (the default) resolves to 200L when derivatives is non-empty and 100L otherwise.

derivatives

Integer vector of derivative orders to compute for every cell, a subset of 1:2. The default 1:2 computes both; integer() computes none.

derivative_ci

The band stored with each derivative curve: "pointwise" (the default), "none" or "simultaneous". Simultaneous bands use the Monte Carlo critical multiplier of Ruppert, Wand and Carroll (2003) as applied to GAMs by Simpson (2018).

derivative_ci_nsim

Number of Monte Carlo draws for derivative_ci = "simultaneous"; 1000L by default and at least 100.

p_adjust

Multiplicity adjustment of the smooth F-test p-values across the k(k - 1) directed cells: "none" (the default), "BH" or "holm", applied once with stats::p.adjust(). Raw and adjusted values are both kept.

shape_cutoffs

Named list of classification thresholds, from janusplot_shape_cutoffs(), mapping the shape indices to a shape_category label.

k_check_thresholds

Named list with entries edf_ratio, k_index and p for the basis-dimension diagnostic that follows mgcv::k.check(). NULL (the default) uses edf_ratio = 0.9, k_index = 1 and p = 0.05.

auto_refit_k

Logical. When TRUE, a cell flagged by the k-check is refitted with a doubled basis until the flag clears, the distinct-value cap is reached or k_max_iter doublings have run. The diagnostic is computed either way; the default is FALSE.

k_max_iter

Maximum number of doublings per cell when auto_refit_k = TRUE; 2L by default.

discrete

Logical. Passes mgcv's covariate discretisation to mgcv::bam(); FALSE by default and ignored for engine = "gam".

nthreads

Integer. Threads used inside each mgcv::bam() fit; 1L by default, which avoids oversubscription under parallel = TRUE. Ignored for engine = "gam".

parallel

Logical. When TRUE, pairs are fitted with future.apply::future_mapply() under the user's future::plan(); FALSE by default.

keep_fits

Logical. When TRUE, the mgcv model objects are kept in $fits and as fit_yx / fit_xy of every pair; FALSE (the default) keeps metrics and prediction grids only.

Value

A janusplot_fit object; see janusplot_fit(). Its call component records the janusplot_data() call as made.
